A great teacher
The bell rings, and their / my English teacher comes in. “My name’s Pan Ming. What’s your / his name?” He asks us to introduce ourselves.
“How about you first?” I / he look up. My eyes meet his / ours.
I feel so nervous. And I give a silly answer! “I’m fine, thank you, sir!”
My face turns red. But Mr Pan just looks at me / her with a smile and says, “Oh, Fine is a great name!”
His / Our clever words make me feel better. I’m so lucky to have a teacher like him.
Grammar rules ⇢ p136
